items.quote: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true.
items.contrast: The request is motivated by the certainty of the man of God’s message, not merely by the fact that the speaker has just buried him.
items.reason: “For” directly presents the message’s certain fulfillment as the reason for the burial request. The key captures that relation uniquely. However, “the man” is an avoidably vague label because the window also refers to “the man of God”; the stem should identify the speaker as the man who buried him.
